comparison.objective: Break a circuit board from its scored panel over a support edge and place the board in a tray.
comparison.physical_skill: Align a V-score to an edge, apply controlled downward bending, manage fracture, and tray the separated board.
comparison.success_condition: Valid downward break at the aligned score without lifting/twist, board in tray, frame safely supported, both released and still for one second. Numeric rubric is present.
comparison.reason: Controlled fracture and post-break placement are meaningfully different from aperture-mediated media recovery and workpiece retention.
